svg.title: Figure 3-2 · ODD speed–curvature envelope
svg.desc: Plot of minimum curve radius R in metres against ego speed 0 to 130 km/h. The solid curve R_ctrl = v²/3.0 m/s² is the controller lateral-acceleration limit; the dashed curve R_ODD = v²/2.5 m/s² is the proposed ODD bound. Above R_ODD is inside the proposed ODD; between the curves is the 0.5 m/s² margin; below R_ctrl is beyond controller authority. Both are driver tasks. Table points: 40 km/h R_ctrl 41 m, R_ODD 49 m; 60 km/h R_ctrl 93 m, R_ODD 111 m; 80 km/h R_ctrl 165 m, R_ODD 198 m; 100 km/h R_ctrl 257 m, R_ODD 309 m; 120 km/h R_ctrl 370 m, R_ODD 444 m. Speed bounds 90 and 120 km/h are marked. Both curves assume AOU-01, EPS torque authority, which is unverified (GAP-04).
svg.text: Minimum curve radius against ego speed: the controller limit, the proposed ODD bound and the margin between them.
(and speed within the ODD-H / ODD-A bound)
for controller error, road crown and wind
outside the proposed ODD: driver task
above the ODD-H speed bound (120 km/h, §3.1)
points and numbers: §3.2 table (rounded to 1 m); curves: the §3.2 formulas
Footnote: both curves assume the EPS torque authority suffices to reach the lateral acceleration. That is not yet characterised (GAP-04, AOU-01); OI-2 confirms or adjusts R_ODD.
